warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.note: Warm-up only. Not a range builder.

warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.note: Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean. Hips stop you before the knee does.

warmup.name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
warmup.note: Slow, no hands if you can.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: From 90/90, torso down over the front leg to the floor and back. Hands assist at first; goal is the glute lifting you unaided.

warmup.name: Side plank
warmup.dose: 5 x 8 s per side, 2-3 s between
warmup.note: Knees or feet. No top-leg raise.

warmup.name: Side-lying hip abduction
warmup.note: NEW - you asked for this on 08-09. Straight top leg, lift to ~30 deg, no rolling back. If you still cannot feel the glute after two sessions, say so and it comes back out.

warmup.name: Seated good morning, unloaded
warmup.note: No bar. Hinge-pattern stretch, working toward depth.

warmup.name: Straddle hold
warmup.note: Capped at 60 s so it does not pre-fatigue the box squat.

A.session_notes: FIRST SESSION AFTER BEING SICK: if you still feel weak, take ~10% off every load and cap everything at RPE 7-8. Fever or body aches = do not train. Changes: overhead press goes to 40 (35 was RPE 5). Bench top set 75 for the triple, your call, and we build from there. Back-off stays at 60 and aims for 7 reps so you do not have to hunt for 1.25 plates. Calf raises on the 45 sled in the bench rests. RECOMP VOLUME (+5 sets): lat pulldown 3x10 added, leg press and lateral raise go to 3 sets. Expect ~60 min.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - top set
exercises.notes: +5 from 35 at RPE 5. Front rack, in the rack, bail forward. NEVER behind the neck. RPE 6 or under = 40x7 next time, then 45.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - back-off
exercises.notes: +5. Ribs down, do not lean back to get under it.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: +2.5, your call. RPE 8 at 72.5 last time. Heaviest set first while fresh.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Same 60, one more rep (you did 6 and 7). First rep of each set paused 2 s on the chest. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45 (partial ROM)
exercises.notes: RPE 6 at 135, back to the 145 you have run before. Partial ROM, the knee is the boss. 3rd set added 09-25 for quad volume.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: BACK IN 09-25 for lat volume (recomp block). 45x10 was RPE 8 on 09-06. Chest up, pull to the collarbone, no leaning back. RPE 8 cap, stop on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: 45 s was RPE 6, so 60 s. Ribs down, do not hitch the hip.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: 5 kg x15 was RPE 8, so 7.5 for 10. 3rd set added 09-25.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: 47 -> 33 -> 19 (nearest pin). Last time 43/33/19 gave 29 reps, so the start was too light. Want 10-12 on the first drop, 22-26 total.

B.session_notes: BACK: last Day B gave you the usual back pain the next day, worse with movement and at florbal. So the trap bar gate is CLOSED again, and back extension stays in but lighter: 2x8 at RPE 6, not 3x12 at RPE 9. If the day after is clean, it goes to 2x10, then the trap bar. If the pain comes back again, back extension comes out. Try not to do Day B the day before florbal, or we cannot tell which one did it. Dips get +5 kg, face pull drops to 30 so you hit the full 15. RECOMP VOLUME (+6 sets): leg press 3x10 and lateral raise 2x15 added, face pull to 3 sets. Expect ~50-55 min.

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: CUT from 3x12 RPE 9: the usual back pain followed last time. RPE 6, slow. Hip extension only: squeeze glutes, chin tucked, STOP AT NEUTRAL, never arch past straight. Trap bar stays gated until a Day B with a clean next day.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: Held at +5 (RPE 8). Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Bodyweight. Same stop rule.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: Held at 20 while the back is not quiet. Get the third set to 10. RPE 8 cap. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: +5 kg (bodyweight was RPE 7). Stop at ~90 deg elbow, slight forward lean, do not sink.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45 (partial ROM)
exercises.notes: ADDED 09-25 for quad volume - B had no quad work. Lighter than Day A (130x10, RPE 7-8). Partial ROM, knee is the boss. Keep the lower back flat on the pad.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: ADDED 09-25. Side delts only got 2 sets per rotation. 5 kg x15 was RPE 8.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Down from 40, where you only got 10. Full 15, rear delts and scap retraction, no body english.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 30 -> 20 -> 15. The first drop hit 12 (on target). Last drop goes 10 -> 15 because 37 total means the tail was too light.

C.session_notes: Box squat: 55 was RPE 7, so go for 10 reps at 55, then 60. After the last box squat set, stay standing and hold the bar racked 30-45 s. Hip thrust gave you lower back last time, so same 45 but 8 reps, not 10, and hard focus on the top: ribs down, chin tucked, tilt the pelvis under, stop at neutral. If you feel the lower back again, stop the exercise and tell the log. Pallof stays 18 with a 2 s hold, because your shoulder limits it, not your obliques. Wrist + reverse curl superset in the hip thrust rests. RECOMP VOLUME (+6 sets): goblet box squat 3x12 (same box, no setup) and lat pulldown 2x10 added, DB incline to 3 sets. Expect ~60 min.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - top set
exercises.notes: Same 55, 8 -> 10 reps (RPE 7 last time). Hit 10 at RPE 8 or under = 60x8 next. Sit, do not collapse.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - back-off
exercises.notes: AFTER THE LAST SET: stay standing, hold the bar racked 30-45 s. Ribs down, breathe. This is the carry exposure.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - top set
exercises.notes: Same 45, 10 -> 8 reps: you felt your lower back at RPE 9. Ribs down, chin tucked, posterior tilt, 2 s squeeze, STOP AT NEUTRAL. Any lower back = stop the exercise.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - back-off
exercises.notes: Same cues. Wrist curl + reverse curl superset in these rests.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (half-kneeling)
exercises.notes: 10 per side, 2 s hold at full extension. Shoulder is the limiter, so we add the hold, not load.

exercises.name: Goblet Box Squat
exercises.notes: REPLACES Bulgarian split squat 09-25 (too slow to set up and do per side). Same high box as the box squat, so zero setup. Heaviest DB held at the chest, 3 s down, touch the box, stand. Quad volume with almost no spinal load. RPE 7-8; if 22.5 is easy, slow the lowering to 4 s rather than hunting for a heavier DB.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: ADDED 09-25 - C had no back work. Same cues as Day A.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Same 22.5, 10 -> 8 reps: it was your only RPE 10. Aim for RPE 8.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: +2.5 (15 was RPE 7). Stand against a wall if you start pulling with the back.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 10 -> 7.5 -> 5. Your call: 2.5 was too light to reach failure. Want 10-12 on the first drop, 22-26 total.
